description: This file defines the `RecalculationDetail` class, which models details related to loan transaction recalculations within the loan schedule domain of the Fineract project. It includes fields for transaction date, processing status, and the associated loan transaction, along with constructors and accessor methods.

classes.name: RecalculationDetail
classes.description: Represents details of a loan recalculation, including transaction date, associated transaction, and processing state.

methods.name: RecalculationDetail
methods.description: Constructor initializing the recalculation detail with a transaction date and loan transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.

methods.name: isProcessed
methods.description: Checks if the recalculation detail has been processed.

methods.name: setProcessed
methods.description: Sets the processing state of the recalculation detail.
